body_markdown:
Prepare an RV for storage in Portland by measuring the full vehicle length, cleaning and drying the interior, removing food and perishables, checking for moisture, and confirming the vehicle is operating, registered, and insured. Then compare your RV’s measurements with available[vehicle storage](https://www.publicstorage.com/vehicle-car-rv-storage) spaces at a nearby location.


Public Storage has 113 storage facilities in the Portland area, including 89 locations with car storage, 108 with[drive-up storage](https://www.publicstorage.com/self-storage/drive-up-storage) , and 30 with[24/7](https://www.publicstorage.com/self-storage/24-hour-storage) Access. Units start at $28 per month, and the average monthly unit price is $95.


Portland RV owners can compare locations near the Pearl District, Downtown Portland, Northwest District, Slabtown, Alberta Arts District, Hollywood District, Sellwood-Moreland, Hawthorne, Division, St. Johns, Beaverton, Gresham, and Vancouver. RV storage can also fit owners traveling near Portland International Airport, Portland Expo Center, Portland International Raceway, Forest Park, and the Columbia River Gorge route.


## Portland RV Storage Essentials:


- Measure your RV from bumper to bumper before comparing available spaces.
- Include hitches, bike racks, ladders, cargo carriers, and mounted accessories in the full measurement.
- Confirm the RV is operating, registered, and insured before reserving.
- Remove food, trash, wet items, and personal belongings before storing the vehicle.
- Inspect windows, doors, seals, vents, and storage compartments for moisture.
- Review access hours, vehicle-space dimensions, and location requirements before reserving.
- Follow manufacturer guidance for tanks, tires, batteries, and other maintenance needs.

## What Should You Do Before Storing an RV in Portland Rainy Weather?


Clean and dry the RV before storage, especially after travel during Portland’s rainy season. Rain, damp gear, and moisture in storage compartments can make the RV harder to prepare for the next trip.


**RV storage preparation checklist:**


- Sweep and wipe down interior surfaces.
- Remove trash, food, and perishables.
- Dry towels, floor mats, gear, and storage compartments.
- Check windows, doors, seals, and vents for moisture.
- Clean the exterior as needed.
- Follow manufacturer guidance for tanks, tires, batteries, and maintenance.


Avoid leaving wet items in the RV. A clean, dry interior makes it easier to inspect, organize, and prepare the vehicle before your next trip.


## What Items Should You Remove Before Putting an RV in Storage?


Remove food, perishables, wet items, personal belongings, and prohibited items before storing an RV. Check the vehicle carefully because small items can be left behind in cabinets, cup holders, and exterior compartments.


**Check these RV areas:**


- Kitchen cabinets.
- Refrigerator and freezer.
- Under-seat storage.
- Exterior storage compartments.
- Trash containers.
- Cup holders and snack storage.
- Bathroom cabinets and shower areas.
- Overhead storage and bedside compartments.


Keep registration documents, insurance information, keys, sensitive records, and other important items outside the vehicle-storage space.

## How Do You Choose a Portland RV Storage Location?


Choose a Portland RV storage location based on available space dimensions and how the property fits your travel routine. Consider the route you use for Oregon Coast trips, Columbia River Gorge drives, Mount Hood travel, or other regional destinations.


**Compare these details:**


- Distance from home.
- Current RV or vehicle-storage availability.
- Available space dimensions.
- Access hours.
- Preferred departure route.
- Typical return schedule.
- Location-specific vehicle requirements.


The best choice is a location with an available space that fits your RV’s complete measurement and your expected routine.

## Portland RV Storage FAQs


**Where Can I Find RV Storage in Portland?**
Compare[vehicle storage](https://www.publicstorage.com/vehicle-car-rv-storage) near Downtown Portland, Beaverton, Gresham, St. Johns, Vancouver, and other Portland-area neighborhoods. Public Storage has 113 Portland-area facilities, including 89 locations with car storage, though RV space types and availability vary by property.


**What RV Storage Size Should I Compare in Portland?**
Measure your RV from front to back, including ladders, hitches, bike racks, cargo carriers, spare-tire mounts, and other accessories. Public Storage may offer vehicle spaces up to 20′, 35′, and 50′, depending on the location and current availability.


**What Should I Do Before Storing an RV in Portland?**
Clean and dry the interior, remove food and trash, inspect windows and seals for moisture, and confirm that the RV is operating, registered, and insured. Measure the complete vehicle before comparing available spaces.


**Can I Store a Non-Operating RV?**
No. Vehicles placed in storage must be operational. Confirm current registration, insurance, and location-specific vehicle requirements before reserving.


**Is Drive-Up Storage Available in Portland?**
Yes. Public Storage has 108 Portland-area locations with[drive-up storage](https://www.publicstorage.com/self-storage/drive-up-storage) . Drive-up access can help with loading camping gear, outdoor equipment, boxes, and other bulky travel items.


**Can I Compare 24-Hour Access Options for Portland RV Storage?**
Yes. Public Storage has 30 Portland-area locations with[24/7](https://www.publicstorage.com/self-storage/24-hour-storage) access. Confirm current access hours, vehicle-space availability, and entry requirements at your selected location before reserving.
